subject: Ronaldinho comeback
title: Ronaldinho, 46: Serie C comeback

lines.vo: A forty-six-year-old just made a Serie C comeback. Ronaldinho.
Yes, that one. World Cup, Champions League, Ballon d'Or. The only player ever to win all six big trophies.
So why Ravenna? Italy's third division. Their owner announced it at the World Cup.
Ronaldinho is a player and a minority shareholder. Some reports said mostly marketing.
Sunday, against Forlì: flares, smoke, white shirt. Nineteenth minute, a corner. Saved. Ravenna won two-nil.
He retired on two hundred and ninety-nine career goals. He wants number three hundred. Take your time, maestro.
Think you can call the next one? Free tips, results and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.
